# How Do I Consolidate Reviews From Multiple Booking Channels?


You consolidate reviews by connecting feedback data from each channel to the matching property record, instead of checking every platform separately. On **Jestor** , this connects structured review data to the corresponding property, via webhooks or API when available.


Operators listing properties across multiple channels accumulate reviews spread across different platforms, each requiring separate login and checking.


## What fragmented review checking costs


- Checking multiple platforms separately just to keep up with reviews
- No consolidated view of reputation per property across all channels
- Negative feedback patterns hard to spot when spread across platforms
- Inconsistent response time depending on which channel received the review


## How consolidation works


- Reviews from channels with an available API or webhook can feed a connected record
- Each review connects to the property record, and when possible, the specific stay
- Dashboards show reviews consolidated across channels, not platform by platform
- Negative feedback can automatically trigger a follow-up action


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Webhooks and open API allow connection to platforms that expose those integrations
- Once connected, review data lives in the same structure as the rest of the operation
- Dashboards reveal cross-channel patterns invisible when checking one at a time
- Significantly reduces time spent manually monitoring reputation


Fragmented reviews Consolidated dashboard


Check each platform separately One view across channels


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does this work with any booking platform?** It depends on the platform exposing an API or webhook for connection. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does negative feedback trigger any action automatically?** This can be configured as part of the process.


**Do reviews connect to the specific property automatically?** Yes, once connected relationally.
